Friday Night Ride – Gatos en Ronda

Iowa City, IA · Social

No-drop

Friday Night Ride – Gatos en Ronda is a social group ride in Iowa City, IA. It rolls every Friday at 6:00 pm from Iowa City Bike Library. Pace: intermediate. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bikeiowacity the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Night Ride – Gatos en Ronda group ride

An intermediate-level Friday ride from the community bike shop. No-drop, so nobody gets left behind. The Bike Library also runs beginner-friendly rides on trails and back ways.
